title: M2C tool definition (meta-schema)
description: Shape of every file in protocol/v1/tools/. name, description and input_schema are what a model adapter hands to a provider; version, risk and risk_max are M2C's own.

risk_max.description: Present only when a call can be riskier than the tool's usual level (delete_path: R1 inside the project, R4 otherwise). A call carries risk or risk_max, nothing between.
